Players Committee card image of [[Mindful Of The Future (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “USED: If Maul just swung a lightsaber during battle, that lightsaber may not target again this battle. LOST: If [Episode I] Obi-Wan or non-[Permanent Weapon] Qui-Gon is in battle with a Dark Jedi, add one battle destiny. OR Cancel Maul Strikes or The Phantom Menace.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/mindfulofthefuture.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
